hero.lede: Hi! I'm **Swarnim Doegar**, a full-stack engineer. I design and build systems that have to scale and stay secure, and the interfaces people use them through.

statements: Most of my work falls into four areas: **designing systems that scale, securing them, improving their performance, and diagnosing failures that are not obvious from the outside.** In practice they tend to overlap on the same problem.
I also build the interfaces those systems are used through, from customer-facing dashboards to the SDKs other engineers integrate against.

notes.label: Backend
notes.body: Distributed services, data pipelines, and access control models built to hold up under production load. I own how that work is packaged, deployed and run, not only how it is written.

notes.label: Frontend
notes.body: Customer-facing dashboards, and the SDKs other teams integrate against. I build the supporting APIs alongside them, so the interface and the service behind it are designed together.

education: B.E. Computer Science · Chandigarh University · 2018 to 2022 · 8.10 CGPA
